title: X-LocVul: An Evidence-Propagation Audit of Cascaded C/C++ Vulnerability Detection, Localization, and Explanation
abstract: arXiv:2611.21626v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Developer-facing vulnerability analysis should link a function-level warning to a source location and a supported explanation. Cascaded systems can propagate weak evidence despite plausible components. We present X-LocVul, a measurement-first audit of a modular C/C++ detector-localizer-explainer pipeline combining UniXCoder, CodeT5, and Qwen2.5-Coder. We test whether evidence passed across stages is useful, merely source-resident, or misleading.   Under duplication and temporal-leakage controls, UniXCoder has higher point estimates than CodeBERT, but true-CWE supervision is statistically indistinguishable from a shuffled-CWE control on PR-AUC, MCC, and vulnerable-class F1. Raw generated statements fail exact source matching in 90.83% of cases. translated_title: X-LocVul：级联式C/C++漏洞检测、定位与解释的证据传播审计
translated_abstract: 面向开发者的漏洞分析应当将函数级警告与源代码位置及有依据的解释相关联。级联系统即使在各组件看似合理的情况下，也可能传播薄弱的证据。我们提出了X-LocVul，这是一项以测量为先的审计，针对结合了UniXCoder、CodeT5和Qwen2.5-Coder的模块化C/C++检测-定位-解释流水线。我们检验在各阶段之间传递的证据究竟是有用的、仅停留在源代码层面的，还是具有误导性的。在重复数据与时间泄露控制条件下，UniXCoder的点估计值高于CodeBERT，但真实CWE监督与打乱CWE的对照组在PR-AUC、MCC和漏洞类别F1指标上在统计学上无法区分。原始生成的语句中有90.83%的情况无法与源代码精确匹配。模糊投影达到83.79%的Top-1准确率，比语义投影高出1.59个百分点，尽管其相对于原始排序的优势尚未得到证实。在一项随机的、条件标注的（实验中……摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: X-LocVul对C/C++漏洞检测-定位-解释级联流水线进行了以测量为先的严格审计，揭示出级联系统在各阶段间传播的证据往往薄弱且不可靠：真实CWE监督与随机对照无统计学差异，且超过90%的生成语句无法精确匹配源代码，凸显了此类流水线在证据传播上的可信度问题。
en_tdlr: X-LocVul presents a measurement-first audit of a cascaded C/C++ vulnerability detection-localization-explanation pipeline, revealing that evidence propagated across stages is often weak or misleading—true-CWE supervision is statistically indistinguishable from shuffled controls, and 90.83% of generated statements fail exact source matching.
